rules.permit: A Rio Rancho City Clerk solicitation permit is required for door-to-door order taking (Municipal Code Ch. 113). Apply at City Hall, 3200 Civic Center Cir NE, at least 5 business days ahead, with a current RR business registration ($20 residential solicitor permit incl. background check).
rules.badge: Wear the city ID badge where it can be seen.
rules.no_soliciting: Skip any home with a 'No Soliciting' / 'No Trespassing' sign: do not knock or leave a flyer. Note the address on the sheet. (Honor 'No Solicitation' signs, 113.13.)
rules.mailboxes: Never put flyers in mailboxes (federal law). Tuck them in the door frame or leave them at the door.
rules.restroom: Parks may have no public restroom; each neighborhood's 'restroom' field lists the nearest restroom / water / gas-station stop.
rules.contact: Lost or have a question? Call (505) 750-3019.
rules.full_text: Rio Rancho rules (Municipal Code Ch. 113): a City Clerk solicitation permit is required for taking orders door to door; apply at City Hall, 3200 Civic Center Cir NE, at least 5 business days ahead, with a current RR business registration ($20 residential solicitor permit incl. background check). Knock only 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. at homes. Wear the city ID badge where it can be seen. Honor 'No Solicitation' signs (113.13).
